title: Before You Play GTA 6 Tonight, Know What's In It | Psalm 101:3
description:
GTA 6 easter eggs are all over YouTube this week. One of them is a sacrificial ritual with a pentagram, candles, a body and a demon. Game Rant, Game8 and Yahoo Tech each published a guide to it. Rockstar says the game made $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours (Reuters, Nov 20, 2026), so it is in a lot of homes tonight. The ESRB rates it M for Mature 17+.

"I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes." Psalm 101:3 (KJV)
"And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them." Ephesians 5:11 (KJV)

Type amen, and send this to a friend who needs it.
